 Savic fit, Summerville returns as Inzaghi ‘to assess’ Salem Al-Dawsari for Al-Fateh 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Al-Hilal expect to regain key players for Saturday’s 12th-round meeting with Al-Fateh as they try to move on from Tuesday’s 3-1 loss to Qatar’s Al-Shamal in the AFC Champions League Elite. Simone Inzaghi also has a selection call on the wing after Gabriel Martinelli’s hamstring setback.
 Arriyadiyah reports that Serbia midfielder Sergej Savic has passed fitness tests and declared himself ready, and that Inzaghi plans to call on him against Al-Fateh. Savic sat out the Al-Shamal tie with muscle fatigue.
 OneFootball Videos
 Netherlands winger Crysencio Summerville returns from suspension after missing the last Asian match, adding options in attack for the league fixture.
 Inzaghi will assess Salem Al-Dawsari and Sultan Mandash in Friday’s session to identify Martinelli’s replacement. The final training runs will decide who gets the nod.
 With Savic and Summerville back and that flank vacancy unresolved, attention focuses on Al-Hilal’s starting XI for Al-Fateh. The team want to find their feet again after that continental stumble.
 Source: Goal.com
